nativeJobSessionV1.calledDuring: confirmed Core apply on an operation-owned metadata logical session
nativeJobSessionV1.ownership: independent non-pooled physical connection; autoCommit false; existing runtime physical budget and watchdogs apply
nativeJobSessionV1.guardRule: same operation and opaque lease token required before every query; no editor transaction, cursor, reconnect, connection replacement or configuration change
nativeJobSessionV1.lostOpenRule: the exact operationId may close only its owned connection without knowing the lost token; a replacement logical session cannot confirm old ownership
nativeJobSessionV1.cleanupRule: close physical connection once; cache confirmed or unknown disposal; never commit, CONFIG_COMMIT, enable or return unfinished configuration to a pool
nativeJobSessionV1.configurationRule: Core owns native SQL, configuration phases and dispatch deduplication; connection close does not prove native configuration rollback or completion

nativeJobLegacyV1.calledDuring: confirmed Core apply only; never during SQL preview
nativeJobLegacyV1.prepareRule: one owned physical transaction; SUBMIT returns an exact OUT ID, BROKEN sets the final state with explicit nextDate, then same-session readback; no commit
nativeJobLegacyV1.commitRule: Core records the returned ID before commit; the exact operationId and jobId must match; repeated requests return existing facts without dispatch
nativeJobLegacyV1.rollbackRule: operationId identifies this operation's owned transaction; jobId may be absent only for rollback after a lost prepare response; commit still requires the exact returned ID
nativeJobLegacyV1.unknownRule: lost commit response stays unknown; read the exact ID, never replay SUBMIT, commit or BROKEN
nativeJobLegacyV1.cleanupRule: before commit, confirm rollback or report unknown; discard the physical connection, never activate during cleanup
nativeJobLegacyV1.scope: native Oracle DBMS_JOB; independent of the editor transaction; nextDate is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

nativeJobLegacyObV1.calledDuring: confirmed Core apply on its own metadata session; control dispatch precedes pool checkout and reconnect
nativeJobLegacyObV1.zoneRule: zone is a nullable string, instance must be zero; native INSTANCE readback remains VARCHAR2 or SQL NULL
nativeJobLegacyObV1.prepareRule: owned physical transaction; local BINARY_INTEGER to VARCHAR OUT; BROKEN and complete initial readback before first commit
nativeJobLegacyObV1.finishRule: reuse nativeJobLegacyV1 operation/ID binding and no-replay rules; the Oracle legacy capability and requests remain unchanged
nativeJobLegacyObV1.disposalRule: terminal receipt or same-operation status must explicitly confirm original physical disposal; false is permanent, prepared is not disposed; logical close_session ok does not confirm it
nativeJobLegacyObV1.lostTerminalRule: query original status only; never send another commit or rollback after a terminal dispatch

blobBindStatementsV1.previewRule: complete array length and each previewSql must exactly match statements; unbound sql equals previewSql
blobBindStatementsV1.manualTransaction: same connection, per-batch savepoint, no implicit commit; rollback to savepoint on failure
blobBindStatementsV1.unsupported: reject complete request before executing any statement; no SQL-text fallback
